product.title: Sunset Catamaran Cruise in Ft. Lauderdale

description.text: End the day relaxing on the Atlantic Ocean with this sunset cruise. Hop aboard a comfortable catamaran for this evening excursion and take in views of the mansions on “Millionaires Row” and the Florida coastline. Then, head out to the Atlantic Ocean and catch the sun set, casting fiery hues of orange and red on the water.See stunning views of the sunset from aboard the boat This excursion is great for first-time and returning visitors A glass of champagne is included on this cruise Depart from a central location along the water Ideal for groups on Fort Lauderdale's Intracoastal Waterway who want a private captain without handling marina logistics.
